title: ID0390184-DC/Si-D/BE - [2P0GOc] HPC cooling error (DC 2)
description:

Error on socket two probably a problem with the PCB. Can there be checked via the ecoG what the problem here is.

additional_info.body:
Hello Marnic,
Greetings of the Day!
We have checked the error flags for this charger and found that there is an issue with the digital output to the KF10. We kindly request you to please check the connections from the cable to the HPC Cable Controller, as shown in the schematic.
Please let us know your findings regarding this issue, and also inform us when you plan to visit the charging site, so we can provide any remote support if needed.
Additionally, we do not recommend any part replacements for this charger without expert advice.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0390184-DC/Si-D/BE - [2P0GOc] HPC cooling error (DC 2) CRM:00796000987
additional_info.body:
Dear
Went today on site and checked the following things:
Visual inspection of the cable, everything seems fine no water or burned marks on the plug
Checked the connections of the HPC cable, unplugged them also no difference:
Checked ecoG:
Checked KF10 and cable to KF10 from HPC, all ok:
Since the issue can’t be found at the charger the cable must be the problem. Therefor I’m asking permission to replace the HPC cable.
Br.
